about.title: About EuroSalary
about.intro: EuroSalary calculates gross-to-net (and net-to-gross) salaries for 6 European countries using official tax rules. All formulas run in your browser — your salary never leaves it.
about.how_1: Gross → Net: direct formula evaluation per country module
about.how_2: Net → Gross: binary search (up to 50 iterations, €0.01 tolerance)
about.how_3: Share: all parameters are encoded in the link
about.how_4: Compare: any two countries side by side with the same input
about.note: Tax data: {{year}}. For informational purposes only — not tax advice.
